verdict.rationale: Agent wallets are a fair question for a crypto payments and on-ramp provider, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack shows no programmatic wallet issuance for agents, no scoped agent keys, no policy controls and no documented limits on what an agent can move. The only wallet feature creates a wallet for a human user by email during checkout. The MCP server only searches documentation, and quote limits and guest-checkout limits are adjacent features, not agent-wallet policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, agents can hold and use wallets safely — programmatic wallet issuance for agents with scoped keys, policy controls, and documented limits on what an agent can move
